items.title: Blixo for QuickBooks Online: Faster Cash Application and Fewer Reconciliation Errors
items.summary: Key Takeaways Blixo connects to QuickBooks Online through an authorization flow, after which recurring subscription payments can be routed toward automated reconciliation instead of piling up in a manual review queue. Automated cash application is designed to cut manual touches on repetitive matching work, which is where reconciliation errors tend to slip through. Because the connection uses QuickBooks Online’s API, you’ll generally need an account with the permissions QuickBooks requires to authorize a third-party app. The connection is set up to sync payments, invoices, and customer records between Blixo and QuickBooks Online. You’ll want a chart of accounts with a clearing or undeposited funds account configured in QuickBooks before you connect. Map recurring plans and customers in advance so subscription revenue posts to the accounts you intend. items.title: Blixo with Salesforce: A Faster Quote-to-Cash Setup for B2B Revenue Teams
items.summary: Blixo with Salesforce: A Faster Quote-to-Cash Process Key Takeaways A large share of B2B sales quotes never convert, making speed and accuracy in the quote-to-cash process critical for revenue teams. Companies adopting CPQ software can shorten sales cycles and generate more proposals per rep, but these gains diminish without backend automation. Most quote-to-cash platforms automate quoting and contracting but leave billing, collections, and revenue reporting as manual processes handled in spreadsheets. Finance teams manually rebuild invoices from closed deals, chase overdue accounts, and reconcile payments one by one, creating a primary bottleneck for cash flow. A complete quote-to-cash system connects five layers—quoting, contracting, billing, collections, and revenue reporting—to reduce handoff delays between sales and finance. Sales automation that stops at the signature line forces finance to inherit contracts that still need work to convert into tracked, reconciled revenue. The revenue drag often occurs downstream from the sale, where unreconciled payments and manual invoice generation keep cash stuck despite fast initial quotes. Why Quote-to-Cash Matters for B2B Revenue Teams Speed at the front end of the sales cycle is necessary, but much of the drag happens after the deal closes. When billing and payment reconciliation stay manual, cash flow stalls. This is the layer many platforms overlook, leaving finance teams to manage the transition from closed deal to cleared cash through workarounds.
